documents.title: Citi Handlowy Retail Migration — Completion Report
documents.excerpt: Migration completed 15 June 2026. PLN 22.1B deposits, PLN 6B loans and PLN 8.9B AuM transferred. Day-60 balance retention 94% vs 90% integration case.

documents.title: NBP MPC Decision and Projection
documents.excerpt: Reference rate lowered; projection shows CPI converging to target. Market pricing implies terminal rate near 3.50% by end-2026.

documents.title: Peer Deposit Pricing Tracker — Q3 2026
documents.excerpt: Top-10 bank savings rates down ~60bp QoQ. VeloBank now 35bp above peer median on non-promotional savings, implying room to lower pass-through.

documents.title: ALCO Minutes — IRRBB and Hedge Programme
documents.excerpt: ALCO noted the asset-sensitive 0-3M gap and requested proposals to extend the receive-fixed IRS overlay within the ΔEVE outlier threshold.

documents.title: WIBOR to WIRON Transition — Product Impact
documents.excerpt: New mortgage contracts to reference WIRON per KNF roadmap. Repricing lag and spread adjustment must be reflected in the margin model for FY2027 originations.

documents.title: SME Banking Pipeline Review
documents.excerpt: Working-capital renewals of PLN 2.1B due in H1-27. Peer spread benchmarking shows VeloBank 35bp below median for comparable risk bands.

documents.title: Target Organisation Programme Update
documents.excerpt: Restructuring of up to 950 roles progressing. Branch network consolidation in East region may affect deposit-gathering capacity.

documents.title: VeloLeasing Vendor Programme Performance
documents.excerpt: Equipment and fleet vendor programme volumes up 14% YoY, concentrated in Wielkopolska and Lower Silesia on nearshoring demand.

documents.title: Ex-Citi Cardholder Behaviour Analysis
documents.excerpt: Ex-Citi revolving balances 18% above VeloBank base; GenAI digital channel pre-approved instalment offers converting at 4.8%.

documents.title: Money-Market Fund Inflows — Retail Savers
documents.excerpt: Polish money-market and bond funds saw record retail inflows as deposit rates fell, highlighting outflow risk for rate-sensitive savings balances.
